instruction: Approve all pending venmo payment requests I have received in this or the last month, and withdraw the remaining venmo balance, if any, to my card ending in 1102.
notes: Single-app task (venmo) plus supervisor. The reference solution has 9 calls, which implies exactly two pending payment requests received in April/May 2023; they are modeled as req-1 and req-2 with the static fact (pending-in-window ?r); req-old is a distractor (older or non-pending) that cannot be approved. show_received_payment_requests is called with status=pending and makes all request ids known via (requests-listed). Approvals are paid from the venmo balance (no payment_card_id), so afterwards the whole remaining balance is withdrawn to the card ending in 1102, leaving the balance at 0. Ordering is enforced without quantification: approving a request retracts (balance-up-to-date) and (balance-settled), show_venmo_balance re-establishes (balance-up-to-date), and withdraw requires an up-to-date balance plus the listed cards; hence any optimal plan approves every in-window request before checking the balance and withdrawing. supervisor-complete-task takes no API arguments (no answer required) but carries the task records so that its precondition mirrors the goal conjunction exactly; it is the only action that asserts (task-completed) and every other action requires (not (task-completed)).
